texts: When the teacher himself wanders lost, whom can his followers follow? Both will sink together before the road ends
greedy teacher's lies
doha on fake gurus who just want your money
my cousin paid a huge sum to attend a retreat run by a man who clearly had no wisdom of his own and talked mostly about donations
Write a verse about a so-called master who knows nothing himself but leads his followers on anyway, charging fees for secrets he never possessed, and ruining both his students and himself in the end
Write me a doha about a false teacher who spins fine words like a weaver at his loom, never producing real cloth, and the foolish pupil who pays dearly to learn nothing of the truth
my uncle spent years learning from a man who sat at his loom all day talking big about enlightenment but never practised a word of it
At the loom of lies the false master weaves a tale of wisdom, but his cloth is empty and his student is fooled
false teacher, loom
doha pls on a fake teacher at a loom who claims to know everything
crossroads, winnowing fan, false teacher
Please compose a doha about a greedy teacher who stands at the crossroads giving contradictory directions, winnowing the seeker's money from his pocket, but never separating real truth from the husk
a doha about a false guru at a crossroads and his winnowing fan, who sells empty talk
my aunt followed a man who gave her a different direction at every crossroads of her life, and his winnowing fan of a mouth blew away her savings
At the crossroads the false master calls to every wanderer, and his winnowing fan sifts only coins, never truth
a man in my aunt's village collected gifts for years claiming to teach spiritual secrets, but when she asked him a simple question, he had no answer at all
doha on teachers who teach for money and not for truth
greedy fake teacher
The master sells his word at a price; the buyer finds in it only echo, and the seller only gain
I want a doha about the teacher whose real aim is the pupils' purses, who pretends to know divine secrets, and who sends his followers home just as ignorant as before, only poorer than when they came
my friend's guide pulled him along by a rope of promises, claiming enlightenment was near, while he himself did not know the way
rope, false teacher
Write a doha about a false teacher who ties the follower with a rope of promises and leads him around in circles, claiming to know the road, though he himself is lost and will drag the student down
doha on a fake guru and a rope pls, the kind that leads you nowhere
The false master ties a rope around your hope and calls it liberation, but the rope leads only deeper into the dark
the ignorant leading ignorant
need a doha about guides who dont know the way themselves but act like they do
my mother joined a group led by a man with huge claims and no knowledge, and it took her three years to see he had nothing to give
If the guide himself has lost the road, how shall the followers find the end? Both will fall into the same pit

Looking for a doha about the ignorant master who leads other ignorant ones, pretending that he knows the road to truth, so that the teacher and the taught both stumble and fall, because neither one actually sees
lock, moth, false teacher
Write a doha about a greedy master who locks his students into endless dues and rituals, while they, like a moth drawn to a dazzling show, give him all they have and gain nothing of truth
doha on a fake guru, lock and moth, he traps people
The moth rushes toward the false master's glow, and the lock of his promises clicks shut behind it
my brother, drawn like a moth to a charming preacher, signed away his savings and found the lock on the gates of that ashram would not open for him to leave

Can you shape a verse about a teacher who puts on a bright forehead mark and a saintly face but thinks only of the coins in the donation box, and who sends his innocent followers into deeper ignorance
forehead mark, false teacher
my neighbour wears a big forehead mark and calls himself a master, but the only thing he teaches is how to pay him
doha on a fake guru with a forehead mark who loves money
The forehead mark gleams on the false master's brow, but within there is only greed, and the follower pays for the mark
doha on a false guru under a date palm, thorn bushes for his students
The date palm is tall but its fruit is out of reach, and a thorn lies beneath it; so is the false master
Write a doha about a false teacher who is tall as a date palm yet gives no fruit or shade to walkers, and whose thorn pricks the follower who comes for wisdom but receives only pain
my cousin's teacher looked impressive as a date palm in a desert, but every time my cousin came close, only a thorn and demands awaited him
date palm, thorn, false teacher
doha on a rope and a greedy guru who doesn't show any real way
The false master offers a rope with nothing at its end, and the drowning soul clings to it all the way down
rope, greedy teacher
my friend's coach promised to pull him up by a rope to the top, then kept collecting fees and let him fall each time
Give me a doha on a false master who throws a rope to the drowning student but ties it to nothing, taking his fees first and leaving the follower to sink as he stands safely on the bank
doha on a fake guru who struts like a peacock lol
peacock, false teacher
the preacher in our town struts around like a peacock, all show and fine robes, but his students say he cannot answer a single doubt

Please write a doha about a teacher who struts like a peacock with proud feathers and grand speeches, but cannot guide a single student past even the first step of truth because his knowledge is just as hollow
The peacock spreads a magnificent tail, but beneath are ugly feet; so the false master dazzles and hides his ignorance
Compose a doha about a teacher who throws his students into the furnace of rituals and fees, not to purify them but to profit, and who does not have a single ounce of wisdom himself
furnace, false teacher
The false master stokes the furnace of fear and cooks his followers for a price, and no wisdom comes out
my sister's yoga master kept raising fees every month, with some excuse of a special furnace purification, and in the end she found out he knew nothing of what he claimed
doha pls about a greedy guru and a furnace of fees
door, stars, false teacher

Looking for a doha about the false master who opens a door to a fake heaven and promises the stars to his followers, only to take their money at the door and offer them nothing but empty words afterwards
He opens a door onto painted stars and the foolish walk through; behind it lies only an empty room
doha about fake gurus, door and stars, he promises you the sky
a man at our door selling spiritual guidance swore he could give us the stars, and wanted only money for it first

I need a doha for a master who talks beautifully about things he has never lived, accepts gifts and honour for what he does not possess, and sends the sincere seekers home confused and empty-handed at the end
hollow teacher, empty words
doha on teachers who teach what they dont know themselves
He speaks of seas he has never seen, and the listener drowns in his borrowed words
my college professor taught from the same notes for thirty years without understanding any of it, and made us suffer the same
a self-styled master in our town is carried everywhere in a palanquin by his followers, and he has not taught them one honest thing
doha on a fake guru carried in a palanquin lol
palanquin, false teacher
The false master rides a palanquin on the shoulders of the foolish, and neither knows where the road leads
Compose a doha about a teacher who sits in a palanquin carried by his gullible followers, collecting praise and offerings, and who wouldn't even know how to lead them a single true step on foot

Can you shape a verse about how the false teacher gives salt for sugar, selling bitter tricks as sweet wisdom, while the follower who is hungry for truth tastes the salt too late and goes home thirsty and poorer
salt, false teacher
my aunt's teacher said he had a cure for the sorrow, took her money month after month, and all she tasted in the end was salt in her wounds
doha on a fake guru and salt, he makes everything bitter
The false master sells you salt and calls it sugar, and the thirsty mouth learns the truth only after it has swallowed
The false master sells glass for a pearl, and the fooled disciple wears it proudly till the world laughs
doha on a fake teacher & a pearl, he sells you glass
Write a doha about the greedy teacher who sells fake pearls of wisdom, polished by false words, to simple followers who cannot tell paste from the real thing until they have emptied their pockets
someone in my town paid a lot for a pearl his master swore would bring him wisdom; it turned out to be plastic, and the master vanished
false teacher, fake pearl
doha on teachers who lead students astray

Please write a doha about the dangers of a false master who leads sincere students astray, smiling and confident, while the students trust him blindly and only realise too late that he has no knowledge of where he is going
I spent two years following a self-proclaimed expert's advice about life and realised he had never done any of it himself
Wrong teachers are like wrong roads, pleasant at the start and cruel at the end, leaving the wanderer far from home
misleading teachers
The tortoise hides its head in its shell, the false master his ignorance in words, and the bitter gourd stays bitter though bathed in praise
the tortoise-slow guru in our town talks about patience but charges for every sermon, and his bitter gourd of advice has made nobody wiser
doha on a fake guru, a tortoise, and a bitter gourd
tortoise, bitter gourd, false teacher

Give me a doha on a false teacher who is slow as a tortoise to give real wisdom but quick to take payment, and whose advice is like a bitter gourd, never sweetening however much a follower chews on it
Though he bathes the stone in honeyed praise, it stays a stone; so is the false master, empty beneath the show
Write a doha about a teacher who gives his students a stone and calls it a gem of wisdom, taking their savings in exchange, though a stone is a stone and the follower is left with nothing at all
stone, false teacher
doha on a fake guru and a stone, same thing
my father's guide asked him to carry a stone from the far country as a task for enlightenment, then asked for money, and the stone sat on our shelf for years

Write a doha on how the false teacher is worse than a common thief, for the thief takes only goods, while the false master steals away the seeker's faith and time and sends him wandering without any hope
false teacher, thief
doha on a false guru who is basically a thief lol
a smooth talker in our colony convinced old people to hand over their savings for his divine blessings, then disappeared like a thief in the night
The thief steals what you hold, the false master what you hope; and the second thief is the worse
doha on false teachers who sell secrets
He sells the secret that he never held, and the buyer treasures it as if it were the sky itself
I'd like a doha about a teacher who claims to hold a secret mantra and will tell it only for a price, though the secret is empty, and the follower who paid ends up exactly as ignorant as he began
a stranger at the bus stand offered to reveal my fate for a hundred rupees, and my grandmother warned me about men who sell such secrets
teacher selling secrets
Write a doha about a teacher who smears sandalwood paste on his forehead and speaks softly of peace, but his heart is full of greed and cunning, making his followers poorer and no wiser than before
The sandalwood stays cool though venom coils around it, but the false master's smooth speech hides poison within
doha on a fake guru wearing sandalwood paste while he is full of poison
sandalwood, false teacher
the man who runs the meditation centre near us always smells of sandalwood and talks of peace, but the fee for each class is going up every single week
doha on a fake guru, needle and pot of water pls
He sews with a needle that has no eye and tries to fill a pot of water that has no bottom; such is the false master
my mother tried to fill a pot of water by following a teacher's instructions, but his needle of advice only pricked her; he knew nothing
Please write a doha about the false master who tries to stitch the follower's torn heart with a needle that has no eye, and fill the pot of water of his life from a vessel full of holes
needle, pot of water, fraud
The false master dilutes the milk of truth and sells it dear, and the thirsty child grows weak on it
my neighbour takes lessons from someone who mixes a few borrowed lines with a lot of nonsense and bills him for a full course; it's like buying watered milk
doha on a fake guru and milk, he mixes water in it
false teacher, watered milk

Can you shape a verse about a teacher who waters down the milk of true knowledge before selling it to his followers, giving them thin and tasteless words, while he gets rich on the price he charges for pure wisdom
doha pls on a greedy priest who is a fake teacher

Write a doha on a priest who poses as a teacher of truth but cares only for offerings and gifts, who has not understood the scriptures himself, and who sends his pupils away as lost as they were before coming
The priest sells prayers by the hour and calls it teaching, but his student walks away with only a lighter purse
the priest in our colony is greedy, he teaches only what brings him donations, and the young people who trust him go astray
greedy priest, false teacher
gold, tree, false teacher
Under the tree of false wisdom he piles gold, and the wanderer who rests there walks on poorer than before
a fraudulent spiritual master in our area sat under a big tree and collected gold from the old women, all while swearing that he had renounced all wealth
doha pls on a false guru with a gold ring under a tree, scamming folks
Give me a doha on a false teacher who sits under a great tree and lets his followers pile gold at his feet in return for empty promises, while the real seekers walk away with no wisdom and no shade
oil press, false teacher
my aunt's savings were pressed out of her by a man who promised a spiritual cure, she says it was like an oil press that never stopped, month after month
The oil press turns and turns, and the false master squeezes the poor for the last drop, while nothing he says is true
doha on a false guru and an oil press, he squeezes his followers dry

Please write a doha about a greedy teacher who runs his followers through the oil press of constant fees and sacrifices, squeezing every last drop of their savings, though what he gives in return is just husk
a man near the mosque in our old town claimed to heal people with charms, and the poor workers who came with a grindstone's worth of savings left with nothing
Write a doha about a false teacher who sits in the mosque and talks of God while he grinds his followers under the grindstone of fees and fear, giving them husk while he keeps the flour
mosque, grindstone, false teacher
doha pls on a fake preacher at a mosque who uses a grindstone on his followers
He preaches in the mosque and sells charms at the grindstone, and either way the follower is ground down
my friend is like a moth around every fashionable guide who comes to town, and one of them, a slow tortoise of a man, took everything he had
doha on a false guru, a moth and a tortoise
moth, tortoise, false teacher
Looking for a doha about a false teacher whose followers are like moths rushing toward a shining show, while he himself, slow as a tortoise to give real knowledge, hides in his shell of excuses
The moth is drawn to the false master's glitter and the tortoise to the shell of his lies; both are lost
The false master begs from his followers while calling himself a king; the true beggar is the one who has no truth
a beggar on our street told me honestly that the famous teacher who had everyone's money was poorer in wisdom than he was
doha pls, a fake guru is the real beggar
beggar, greedy teacher
Write a doha about the greedy teacher who calls himself a master but is truly a beggar, always asking his followers for money, and who is poorer in wisdom than the actual beggar sitting outside
Can you shape a verse about a false master who plays the thief, taking the diamond that the follower gave in trust, with his promises of divine reward, and leaving the student with only regret
The thief steals the diamond from the wise, and the false master steals the sight from the foolish
my aunt gave her diamond to a fraud who said it would bring her a spiritual boon, and he vanished like a thief the same night
thief, diamond, false teacher
doha on a false guru who runs off with a thief's loot, diamonds from fools

Compose a doha about a false teacher who rings a bell to attract followers and fills the air with noise about wisdom, but behind the clanging there is nothing, and the crowd goes home emptier than it came
The bell rings loud, but the hollow bell has no truth within; so the false master clangs on and on
there is a man in our colony who rings a bell every morning to announce his teaching, but the only lessons he gives involve donating to him
bell, false teacher
doha on a false guru and a bell he rings for attention
net, well, false teacher
doha on a fake teacher, net and well, trapping people
The false master casts a net with a well-fed smile, and the fools of hope leap in; later the well is dry
Give me a doha on a false teacher who casts a net of sweet promises over the village well where the thirsty gather, trapping them with fees, and drawing no water of truth for anyone who trusted him
the con man who came to our village gathered everyone near the well, cast his net of promises, and left in a week with the donations
The sandalwood paste on the false master's brow is fragrant, but his heart is cold and hard with greed
sandalwood, greedy teacher
Please write a doha about a false teacher who wears the cool sandalwood of saintliness on his forehead while his words are poison and his heart is hot with greed, a danger for any trusting student
a famous sandalwood-scented preacher charges my sister a monthly fee for guidance and gives her nothing but recycled quotes
doha on a false guru wearing sandalwood paste
short doha on the dangers of a false teacher

Write a verse about a teacher who has never practised what he preaches, who loves praise more than the truth, and whose gullible followers go on worshipping him even as he leads them away from the very thing they want
my friend's mentor kept telling him to give up greed, while quietly adding a new car every year, and my friend only noticed after a decade
A hollow word from a hollow master rings emptily down the years, and the seeker is left with his hunger
teacher without truth

Write a doha about a false teacher with a honeyed tongue that traps the foolish like a fly in sweet syrup, whose words are sweet but whose purpose is only to empty the follower's purse and leave him stuck
a talkative man with an oily tongue told my grandmother that flies would never touch the offerings if she paid him for a special blessing, and she did
tongue, fly, false teacher
The tongue of the false master drips honey, and the fly that settles there is caught and lost
doha on a fake guru's honeyed tongue and the fly he traps
a thief in a saffron robe moved into our neighbour's home as a spiritual guide, and within months the family's savings were gone
thief, false teacher

Looking for a doha about a thief who learns to dress as a teacher, speaking softly of detachment, because the trusting find it easy to give their wealth to one who seems holy, and so the thief grows rich
In the saint's dress walks the thief, and the fool bows low and hands him the key to his own treasure
doha on a fake guru, a thief in saintly dress
oil press, well, false teacher
The oil press crushes the grain and the false master the seeker, while the well of his wisdom gives only dust
doha on a false guru, oil press and well

Compose a doha about the false teacher who stands beside the well and the oil press, offering water of wisdom that is dry, and pressing out the little the follower owns while promising to improve his fate
near the well in my old village there was an oil press where a fake holy man used to take payment from the poor workers for useless advice
any doha on a false guru who wants your money
He pointed the way with confident hand, yet had never walked a step of it himself

I want a doha that warns the seeker about the teacher whose smile is wide and whose promises are bigger, but who actually has no knowledge and will let the seeker pay for years before the truth is revealed
teacher, but a fraud
I trusted a man who said he would show me the path to inner peace and I realised too late he only wanted me to keep paying him
lock, washerman, false teacher
doha on a false guru who locks his teaching away, washerman is more honest
The lock on the false master's wisdom opens only to a purse, while the washerman cleans cloth for honest bread
the washerman by our canal knew more honest wisdom than the paid counsellor, whose lock on his wisdom only opened for fees

Can you shape a verse about the false teacher who keeps his supposed secrets under lock and demands payment for each, while the simple washerman, scrubbing cloth by day, knows an honest life better than he does
doha on fake guru, peacock & forest
my father followed a preacher into the forest ashram who strutted like a peacock before the crowds and had nothing of substance to say at all
In the forest the peacock spreads his plume to hide a heart of deceit, and the lost follow his colours into the dark

Please write a doha about a fake teacher who dances like a peacock at the edge of the forest to lure innocent wanderers, then robs them of their trust and savings, vanishing into the dark when they ask hard questions
peacock, forest, false teacher
my younger brother was told by his supposedly spiritual mentor to hand over his first salary every month, and I could see that the man had never helped him
I'd like a doha about how a teacher who loves profit more than truth is a danger, since the sincere seeker who believes in him puts all his hope into something that is empty at the very centre
Gain is the master's only god, and teaching is the dress he wears when he goes out
greed disguised as teaching
doha on fake teachers who care only about their own gain
He holds up a mirror to every follower's faults but never turns it to his own face

Write a doha about the false teacher who is quick to show a mirror to the faults of his followers, yet cannot bear to look into the mirror himself, since there he would see his own ignorance and greed
my old tutor loved pointing out everyone's mistakes but, whenever I held up a mirror to his own, he grew angry and cancelled my classes
doha on a fake guru and a mirror, he cant see his own flaws
mirror, false teacher
One who has not tasted the fruit describes its sweetness, and the hungry believe him until they starve
Give me a doha on the teacher who describes the Lord in a hundred ways without ever having met Him, who sells descriptions of salvation to those who want it, and who ends up with all of them lost
doha on gurus who dont know the truth but sell it
teachers who mislead
a speaker in my college used to give talks on honesty, then was caught taking bribes from the very students he lectured to
He trades in faith as a merchant trades in grain, and weighs the sorrow of the poor by the coin it brings
a local spiritual speaker offered my mother a special blessing package, and she realised that people had bought several such packages already
trading faith for profit
doha pls on teachers who use faith for profit

Compose a doha on a so-called master who uses people's faith as his business, selling hope on Sundays and holidays, taking donations without count, and giving the believers in return nothing but longer queues
Many masters crowd the road, each crying that he alone knows the way, and the seeker loses himself among their cries
fraud master, foolish disciples
Looking for a doha about an age when false teachers are numerous and true ones rare, when every roadside voice claims to show the way, and the poor seeker must be careful whose hand he takes
doha on too many fake masters around nowadays
three of my friends joined different spiritual groups, and each leader promised something grander, yet all of them were asking only for contributions
my uncle trusted a guide who spoke as sweetly as milk, but his advice nearly cost my uncle his business, and the guide only asked for his fee
doha on a false guru who gives you milk that's actually poison
The false master pours poison into a cup of milk and calls it nectar, and the foolish drink it gladly
Write a doha about a false teacher who offers poison in a cup of milk, wrapping harmful lies in the sweetness of kind words, so that the trusting follower drinks it all and only later feels the sting
milk, poison, false teacher
a smooth-talking man at an inn on the highway offered me spiritual guidance for a price and I realised he had probably said the same to everyone

Can you shape a verse about a false teacher who waits at the inn for weary wanderers, offering them guidance and rest and robbing them of their small savings, vanishing before morning with their trust
doha on a fake guru met at an inn
inn, false teacher
At the inn the false master hunts for tired wanderers, offers a bed of promises, and takes the purse before dawn
greedy master, empty seeker
my cousin loves joining the biggest groups of followers, and each guru he follows has a bigger car but no better answers
doha about teachers who put on a show but know nothing
Where he cannot lead, the false master only shouts, and the echoing valley answers him with his own emptiness
Write a doha about a vain teacher who loves a crowd and nothing else, who measures his wisdom by the number of followers behind him, and who would not know the truth if it came and sat beside him
